news.title: Morgan Stanley debuts ether, solana exchange-traded products after bitcoin fund success
news.summary: The asset manager is offering low-cost ETH and SOL exchange-traded products after its bitcoin fund topped $381 million in assets.

news.title: Hyperliquid is taking crypto perps deep into DeFi’s ‘money LEGO’ land
news.summary: Hyperliquid is capitalizing on the volume and depth of its order book by giving firms the option to compose with the platform’s shared liquidity, rather than fragmenting it.

news.title: Russia outlines new digital depository rules ahead of fall crypto framework roll-out
news.summary: The central bank's draft rules require digital asset platforms to hold up to $2.8 million in liquid capital as a sweeping regulatory framework looms.

news.title: Ethereum startup EthSystems bets privacy is key to getting banks on public blockchains
news.summary: EthSystems, which spun out of the Ethereum Foundation earlier this month, is focused on building privacy infrastructure for banks and other financial institutions.

news.title: Ondo drops tokenized asset blockchain plans for private, high-speed trading network
news.summary: The new network powers Ondo's recently-launched perpetual futures platform and will eventually support trading across onchain financial assets.

news.title: 'Anything remotely dovish' from Fed could be good for bitcoin, says analyst
news.summary: Traders are divided on whether the Fed will hike rates, but analysts said crypto may be less exposed than AI-driven tech stocks.

news.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
